baseline_comparison_limit: Three shared failed nodes were originally blocked by missing LiteLLM embedding configuration; matching failed nodes does not establish identical execution paths. No controlled environment baseline rerun was performed in this analysis.
limitation: The failures do not verify current SQL/rerank/audit internals or live production behavior because many abort before these stages. No claim of overall production correctness.
